verdict.rationale: Whether a speech-to-text service publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an open-source license or public source code. Mentions of SDKs, code samples, and the Reverb ASR model name do not establish that the product's source is openly licensed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
